coverage: title + tagline + job relevance + 8 outcomes + 8 theory code/output blocks + 9 callouts + 1 figure

top_level.current_content: Una corrida genera dashboard, DOCX/PDF y workbook con números reconciliados, provenance y revisión visual
top_level.improved_content: Una corrida genera dashboard, Excel y DOCX/PDF desde un payload validado; después reabre, reconcilia y registra los artefactos antes de enviarlos a revisión visual.
top_level.justification: The current tagline states a gate the examples do not earn and uses avoidable English.

top_level.current_content: En analytics y operaciones en Perú, el comité no acepta un Excel «bonito» si el DOCX dice otro número. Aquí aprendes a construir un factory de reportes que une dashboard, Excel y documentos reales con métricas reconciliadas, provenance (trazabilidad de origen) y aprobación humana. Es lo que separa un informe que pasa auditoría de uno que se desmorona en la primera pregunta.
top_level.improved_content: En analítica y operaciones del Perú, un comité no puede confiar en un Excel y un DOCX que muestran cifras distintas. Aquí aprenderás a construir una factoría de reportes que genera los artefactos desde un payload común, vuelve a extraer sus métricas, las reconcilia, registra su trazabilidad y deja la aprobación final a una persona revisora.
top_level.justification: Spanish-first wording and an evidence-derived workflow rather than assumed reconciliation.

theory_code_outputs.evidence: Output reproduces exactly, including HTML escaping. The code still has no versioned ctx and uses default Undefined.
theory_code_outputs.proposed_patch: Use Environment(undefined=StrictUndefined, autoescape=select_autoescape(...)); create ctx={schema_version,run_id,payload_id,metrics,limits}; demonstrate a missing required key raising.

theory_code_outputs.evidence: Published rows both contain numbers. Adding the promised median=None case raises TypeError before an em dash can be rendered.
theory_code_outputs.proposed_patch: Branch on None/status before numeric formatting; use one format_metric function with explicit missing/redacted states.

theory_code_outputs.evidence: DOCX reopens and text checks pass. Actual reopened styles are Title, Heading 1, Normal, but the code never asserts them.
theory_code_outputs.proposed_patch: Inspect reopened.paragraphs styles, expected hierarchy, table header semantics and actual visual alternative properties where present.

theory_code_outputs.evidence: Digital PDF extraction and PNG creation succeed, but there is no image-only negative fixture, no needs_ocr field, no visual review and no PDF accessibility evidence.
theory_code_outputs.proposed_patch: Import pymupdf; add image-only fixture and needs_ocr; record manual/render QA; either validate tagged-accessible PDF or state accessibility is not established by this renderer.

theory_code_outputs.evidence: Hardcoded dict prints expected strings but no pack_report/validator exists and decision=None is absent.
theory_code_outputs.proposed_patch: Implement validate_report requiring resumen/metodo/hallazgos, n/unit, evidence ids, limits and explicit pending human decision. Use coherent Peru geography.

theory_code_outputs.evidence: assert '40' in caption is a substring check; code opens no PNG/XLSX/DOCX and contains no run_id comparison.
theory_code_outputs.proposed_patch: Extract canonical metric records from actual artifacts and compare key/metric/value/unit/n/filter/precision/run_id.

theory_code_outputs.evidence: [28.04,28.0,28] all become 28.0 after one-decimal float rounding, so different source values are declared consistent. No a11y check is executed.
theory_code_outputs.proposed_patch: Compare canonical Decimal/integer-cent values before display formatting; separately compare formatted strings; execute structured DOCX/PDF accessibility checks.

theory_code_outputs.evidence: dashboard/xlsx/doc='ok' are constants; only b'synthetic' is hashed; no output files/checklist are inspected and no manifest is saved.
theory_code_outputs.proposed_patch: Derive checks from files, compute SHA-256, implement ready(all required checks), atomically persist/reopen manifest.json with pending_review.
